_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

data.name: transactions
constraints: CHECK (type NOT IN ('expense', 'income') OR category_id IS NOT NULL)

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "wallets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EUR', "initial_balance_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "initial_balance_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "include_in_total" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("include_in_total" IN (0, 1)), "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, "last_balance_verified_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "categories" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transactions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'confirmed', "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "recurrence_id" TEXT NULL, "occurrence_date" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("recurrence_id", "occurrence_date"), CHECK (type = 'adjustment' OR amount_cents > 0), CHECK (type NOT IN ('expense', 'income') OR category_id IS NOT NULL), CHECK ((type = 'transfer') = (to_wallet_id IS NOT NULL)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "transaction_labels" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "label_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("transaction_id", "label_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "transaction_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sha256" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_rules" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_cents" INTEGER NOT NULL, "currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "wallet_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "to_wallet_id" TEXT NULL, "category_id" TEXT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "label_ids" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, "by_weekday" INTEGER NULL, "by_month_day" INTEGER NULL, "by_month" INTEGER NULL, "start_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "end_date" TEXT NULL, "max_count" INTEGER NULL, "mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "paused_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (type IN ('expense', 'income', 'transfer')), CHECK (amount_cents > 0), CHECK (interval >= 1));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "recurrence_exceptions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "rule_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("rule_id", "occurrence_date"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "key" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "app_meta" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "outbox" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "entity" TEXT NOT NULL, "entity_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "changed_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);
